name: Ironvale Demolition
description: Demolition and site clearance contractor in the fictional city of Graymouth.

items.title: Services overview
items.content: Ironvale recycles 93.6% of demolition waste by weight and runs 14 high-reach excavators. Brochure IVD-SRV-14.

items.title: Neighbour information line
items.content: Neighbours of our sites can call 0800 552 0913 between 07:50 and 18:20. Leaflet IVD-NBR-1.

items.title: Exclusion zone rules
items.content: Exclusion zones are 1.5 times the structure height; zone marshals wear orange vests and report to Callum Dunne. Rules IVD-EXZ-15.

items.title: Dust monitoring
items.content: Dust monitors alarm at 0.35 mg per cubic metre; water cannons run during all breaking. Log IVD-DST-035.

items.title: Tower block demolition contract
items.content: Graymouth Council will pay $5.45M to demolish the Seaview Towers by 2027-11-30; blasting is planned for 2027-08-15. Contract IVD-SVT-0815-G.

items.title: Illegal waste dumping allegation
items.content: The environment agency is investigating whether 640 tonnes of our rubble were dumped at Carrbank Farm by a haulier we hired; interview on 2026-11-09. File IVD-ENV-1109-C.
